narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic sketch parodies a dramatic breakup scene between a couple, which is revealed to be taking place at a fan meet-and-greet event for a celebrity. The humor stems from the juxtaposition of their intense relationship drama with the professional, unrelated comments of the celebrity and the eventual 'happy' resolution through shared fandom. It aims to entertain fans of the comedy group 'This Group of People'.
